meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Radio Paradise: hide email and rating prompts and donation pitches; dim or hide home extras; blur channel tiles.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on radioparadise.com/ after the Angular home rendered. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (Chrome and the network were out of memory when retried), the music search, blog and what-is-playing pages. The page has a mobile-only `.action-banner`; Angular keeps both desktop and mobile copies in the DOM.

LIVE counts on Home: email-banners desktop home 5; join-support desktop home 2; extras-dim desktop home 4; extras-hide desktop home 4; listening-map desktop home 1; channel-tiles-blur desktop home 10. Selectors are custom-element tag names and readable class names (action-banner, channel-tile); Angular `_ngcontent-*` attributes are never used. `app-rate-this-prompter` and `app-prompt-alert` were empty shells when captured; they fill in after listening and the rule hides them when they do (INFERRED: contents not seen).

Choices: Lower home sections Show/Dim/Hide (opacity 0.35); Channel tile artwork Show/Blur (blur 8px; no Hide because the grid is the station picker).

NOT verified: logged-in profile UI, phone layout, whether the rating prompter shows a dialog the rule would also hide, Rewards and merch pages.
